conditions.name: Common Cold
conditions.description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract causing mild fever, runny nose, and sore throat.

conditions.name: Influenza (Flu)
conditions.description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses with high fever and body aches.

conditions.name: Malaria
conditions.description: A mosquito-borne disease causing cyclical high fever, chills, and sweating.
medicines: Consult doctor immediately for antimalarial drugs

conditions.name: Typhoid
conditions.description: A bacterial infection causing sustained high fever, abdominal pain, and weakness.
medicines: See a doctor for antibiotics (Ciprofloxacin, Azithromycin)

conditions.name: Tension Headache
conditions.description: Most common type of headache caused by stress, fatigue, or poor posture.
remedies: Rest in a quiet dark room

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: Intense throbbing headache often with nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light.

conditions.name: Sinusitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the sinuses causing pressure headache, nasal congestion, and facial pain.

conditions.name: Common Cold
conditions.description: Viral upper respiratory infection causing dry or wet cough with nasal congestion.

conditions.name: Bronchitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of bronchial tubes causing persistent cough with mucus.

conditions.name: Asthma
conditions.description: Chronic airway inflammation causing wheezing, shortness of breath, and coughing.

conditions.name: COVID-19
conditions.description: Viral infection causing dry cough, fever, fatigue, and loss of smell/taste.

conditions.name: Gastritis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the stomach lining causing burning pain, nausea, and bloating.

conditions.name: Food Poisoning
conditions.description: Caused by contaminated food/water leading to stomach cramps, vomiting, and diarrhea.

conditions.name: Appendicitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the appendix causing sharp pain in lower right abdomen — EMERGENCY.
remedies: Do NOT take painkillers — go to hospital immediately
medicines: Requires immediate surgery — do NOT delay

conditions.name: Pharyngitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the pharynx causing sore, scratchy throat.

conditions.name: Strep Throat
conditions.description: Bacterial infection causing severe sore throat with white patches and fever.

conditions.name: Tonsillitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of tonsils causing throat pain, swallowing difficulty, and fever.

conditions.name: Dehydration
conditions.description: Lack of adequate fluids causing lightheadedness and dizziness.

conditions.name: Vertigo (BPPV)
conditions.description: Sensation of spinning caused by inner ear problems.

conditions.name: Low Blood Pressure
conditions.description: Blood pressure drops causing dizziness, fainting, and nausea.

conditions.name: Heartburn (GERD)
conditions.description: Acid reflux causing burning sensation in the chest.

conditions.name: Heart Attack
conditions.description: EMERGENCY — Blocked coronary artery causing crushing chest pain, arm pain, sweating, and breathlessness.

conditions.name: Anxiety/Panic Attack
conditions.description: Intense anxiety causing chest tightness, rapid heartbeat, and shortness of breath.
remedies: Sit down in a calm place

conditions.name: Anemia
conditions.description: Low red blood cell count causing extreme tiredness, pale skin, and weakness.
remedies: Vitamin C to boost iron absorption

conditions.name: Hypothyroidism
conditions.description: Underactive thyroid causing fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, and depression.

conditions.name: Sleep Deprivation
conditions.description: Insufficient sleep leading to tiredness, poor concentration, and irritability.

conditions.name: Motion Sickness
conditions.description: Dizziness and nausea caused by travel (car, ship, plane).

conditions.name: Gastroenteritis
conditions.description: Stomach flu causing nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and stomach cramps.
remedies: Avoid solid food until vomiting stops

conditions.name: Allergic Reaction
conditions.description: Skin rash caused by allergic response to food, medicine, or environment.

conditions.name: Chickenpox
conditions.description: Viral infection causing itchy blisters all over the body with fever.
